pythonFunction.name: generate_advisor_handoff_summary
pythonFunction.description: Assembles and returns a structured handoff summary for transfer to a licensed human advisor. Includes: identity-verified status, discovery answers (goals, time horizon, emergency fund status, highest-cost debt), any planning framing that was discussed, and the open question or boundary that triggered escalation. Call this BEFORE calling end_session for advisor transfers, so the advisor receives full context and the customer does not need to repeat themselves. The trigger_handler callback calls this automatically when _action_trigger is 'escalate_to_advisor'.
